body.p: Arrow Lake Processor, CPUID processor signatures greater than 000C065xh, introduced a newer cache architecture with below features:

ul.li: CPUID leaf 0x4 added a new sub-leaf to support 3-level cache hierarchy (see Example 3.4.1)

The CPUID leaf 0x4 will provide cache information below:
DFU – L0 Data
IFU – L1 Instruction
MLC – L2
LLC – L3
BIOS should dynamically identify the Max Level and query the data
BIOS Shall report L0 Data Cache for DCU

body.note: The actual L1 Data Cache will not be reported via CPUID instructions. Software may refer to Arrow Lake EDS Vol1 for cache size information in case of reporting.
